limitations_admitted.value: H13CO+ nearly optically thick (~7 K peak), so rarer species are needed

evidence.quote: which means that the line gets almost optically thick and that we need observations in more rare species to look into the central part.

referee_caveats_inferred: Fixed Td=10 K and beta=1 make masses and densities uncertain, and no uncertainties are given
Arc interpretation as turbulent interaction is qualitative
Flux filtering by the interferometer limits the interpretation of the missing systemic emission
MMS-2 'starless' status is not independently established
